description:
Functional scope: remove NodeRouter.with_coordination/2,3; retain direct ConnectorLifecycle and ConnectorRuntime startup protection using existing Coordination.capture/1 and run/2. Mechanically migrate existing locking/peer test setup to a shared test-only coordinate helper; retain all assertions and scenarios.
Action reuse: reuse existing Coordination.capture/run, AsyncHandoff and lifecycle domain APIs. Local-only infrastructure; no new Action, tool, or public NodeRouter function. Contract: same resource IDs, independent holds, default timeout, async handoff, error/exception cleanup and authorization.
Tests before implementation: add public API absence test; confirm existing coordination/peer and lifecycle locking tests as baseline. Paths: local/remote/nested/async/caller death/contention; direct startup and direct workflow archive stay guarded.
Mocking: no new mocks; existing injected runtime and peer nodes only.
Documentation: NodeRouter public docs removal; architecture docs updated with consumer step.
Rollback: reject if any existing assertion needs weakening or any direct entry point loses its continuous hold.
Non-goals: timeout semantics, async redesign, unrelated architecture. E2E unnecessary for behavior-preserving infrastructure refactor; existing feature UX/E2E gate remains separate.

comments.text: Removed public wrapper; direct domain/bootstrap consumers now use existing Coordination.capture/run. Existing scope fixtures migrated mechanically with assertions retained. API-removal test failed before removal and now passes. mix q passed after correcting alias order; focused suite: 49 tests and 2 properties, 0 failures.

title: [zaq-nuz] Remove public wrapper and preserve internal coordination entry points
